descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S27 A re-generate over an existing note fails, then succeeds after the physician leaves: the old note is never presented as the new one; 'generating', then the new note and a summary with nothing invented

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T6 If note generation fails, the Note tab shows an explicit error state, never a blank or fabricated note. (TFA-92595 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U10 Never invent (3.4) in what generation puts on Post-Round: the note and Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary contain nothing that was not dictated or stored (no supplied diagnoses, no invented findings or nor … (UAT 3.4; TFA-92595 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U12 Server-side Generate (3.5): after tapping Generate the physician can move on; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and the note appears when ready whether or not the chart is open. (UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U9 Both modes (ground rule 3.3): TC-17 does not say Hospital-only, so every outcome above must hold in Hospital and in Nursing Home. The ticket has no Hospital/Nursing Home AC (Q3). (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-17) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T7 The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note. (TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A Hospital patient in note-ready with note N-H and a Nursing Home resident with note N-N, each with a saved pre-round; generation forced to fail in part 1 and restored in part 2 (local stack only)

When Part 1 (failure). Hospital: type QA-DICT-9 on Encounter, tap Generate Note & Finish, wait until settled; open Post-Round (cp1); if Copy to EMR is shown, tap it (cp2: the clipboard, captured by the runner). Nursing Home: type QA-DICT-N9 the same way, Generate, Post-Round (cp3). Part 2 (restored). …

Then After the failure Post-Round says the note was not generated and does not present N-H or N-N as the new note (hidden, or clearly labelled as the previous note: Q12); what Copy to EMR puts on the clipboard is recorded. In part 2 Post-Round shows a 'generating' state, then a note that carries the new dictation (metoprolol) although the physician left the char …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Judged: 'not generated' on cp1/cp3 (T6, AC 9) with no endless 'Finalizing'; on cp4 'generating' and not the empty card (U12); on cp5 the new note with metoprolol, the summary heading, and none of the inventions 'sepsis', 'intubat', 'lungs clear', 'within normal limits', which are in neither the dictation nor N-H (U10, 3.4). …

Where it ran: dev; test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
